description: A schedule loss of use apportioned across two to six established claims of one claimant: each case uses its own AWW and date of accident (its own max and min) and its APPORTIONED loss of use for each member, with any protracted healing period, prior payments and credits; returns each case's award, 15% fee rounded down to $5 and net, and the totals. Cases are numbered; no names. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

aww.description: Average weekly wage before the injury, in dollars (gross).

body_parts.description: Each scheduled member and its schedule loss of use percentage. Members: arm, hand, leg, foot, thumb, index/middle/ring/pinky finger, great toe, other toe, eye, one ear, both ears.

credits.description: Optional, dollar credits on this case.

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.

prior_payments.description: Optional, dollars already paid on this case.

name: calculate_apportionment
